# Dolby AC-4 immersive stereo (ac4-ims)

Dolby AC-4 immersive stereo (IMS): a 2.0 AC-4 stream made from an immersive or
surround mix, written as `.ac4`. Every option is on
[deezy encode ac4-ims](../cli/encode-ac4-ims.md). DeeZy 1.x called this format
`ac4`.

```bash
deezy encode ac4-ims movie.mkv
deezy encode ac4-ims --encoding-profile ims_music --bitrate 320 concert.mkv
```

## Sources

TrueHD Atmos, an Atmos master (DAMF or ADM BWF) or a channel-based source of 6
channels or more (7.1 is downmixed to 5.1 first, which is what DEE takes).

## Data rates

<!-- BEGIN generated by scripts/cli_docs.py from 'deezy bitrates': edit deezy/dee/spec.py, not this block -->

```text {.scrollable-code-block}
ac4-ims
  2.0   default 256: 64, 96, 128, 144, 256, 320
```

A rate DEE doesn't take becomes the closest one it does, with a warning.

## Profiles

`--encoding-profile` is `ims` (the default) or `ims_music`, for music. With
`ims_music` DeeZy sets the four device DRC profiles to `music_light` and turns
dialogue intelligence off, as DEE requires.

## Loudness and DRC

DEE measures the loudness and writes it into the stream; `--loudness-preset`
works as for [Dolby Digital](dd.md#loudness). `--ddp-drc` and the four device
profiles (`--flat-panel-drc`, `--home-theatre-drc`, `--portable-headphones-drc`,
`--portable-speakers-drc`) pick the DRC.

## Warp mode

A TrueHD Atmos stream that carries no warp mode reaches DEE with none, which DEE renders as `warping`, its own default. `--thd-warp-mode` gives such a stream one (`normal`, `warping`, `prologiciix` or `loro`). A stream that has a warp mode keeps it. DeeZy 1.x gave every such stream `normal`.

## Sync

DeeZy keeps 1.x's 256-sample delay compensation for IMS. It hasn't been measured
against an AC-4 decoder.
